title: Tighten workspace recovery contract tests and paused-notice presentation
outcome: Consolidated review6468/6469 on frozen7d2ff811: add direct hasPendingWorkspaceLayout tests for typed read failure, invalid/corrupt JSON, empty pending id and no-window guard; integration tests already catch blocked-read regression, so this is focused contract coverage, NOT a P1 untested product defect. Strengthen real App still-blocked Retry assertion to specific message and enabled button. Reuse themed button class; evaluate separating live message region from Retry control and keyboard focus when busy, without blindly adding a modal alertdialog. W3C alert spec/APG supports non-disruptive announcements; no browser/screen-reader reproduction or blanket prohibition on button descendants established. Remove dead serializedWorkspaceLayout===null guard; do not restore readiness-only memo gating because paused edit capture requires current content. Move UI-specific retry wording from storage error to hook, document throwing storage contract and post-commit ref use. Consolidated Low follow-ups only; no production fix implemented here. Inventory with ready direction, no execution owner or scheduled trigger; primary four lifecycle defects remain tm-95c7. Search workspace/storage and current item comments found no matching dedicated test/presentation cleanup task.
